**Chinese name:** 芯动科技 (Xīndòng Kējì)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
China's most valuable domestic semiconductor-IP supplier — the quiet enabler whose PCIe/DRAM/UCIe/UALink PHYs sit inside AI-startup roadmaps across the tracker; its February 2026 120-lane Gen5 PCIe switch and June 2026 UALink suite make it central to de-NVLink scale-up fabrics. 风华3号 (September 2025) keeps a homegrown full-function GPU alive outside the four listed startups. Private, no verified IPO filing.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Interface IP cores, PCIe switches, custom AI SoCs and chiplets, Fenghua-series graphics/compute GPUs.

## Key Facts

| | |
|---|---|
| **Category** | Fabless |
| **Founded** | 2006 |
| **Location** | Wuhan, Hubei |
| **Product Focus** | High-speed interface IP (PCIe 3/4/5/6+CXL3.0, GDDR7, HBM3E/4 PHY, LPDDR6, 224G SerDes, UCIe, full UALink suite), 风华 Fenghua GPUs, custom ASIC/chiplet services |
| **Node Sophistication** | IP proven across advanced nodes (HBM/UCIe/224G PHY imply ≤N5-class enablement); Fenghua GPUs ≤12nm; latest node not verified |
| **Entity List** | No |
